The greediness ladder of the out-of-bag tuning

Source: R/tune.R
greediness_ladder.Rd

The points of greediness that rpf(tune = ) searches: pairs of n_try_split_points (split points tried per split candidate) and share_candidates (share of the possible splits drawn as candidates in each round), greediest first. Each step down the ladder halves share_candidates and n_try_split_points (rounded up, at least 1), from 40 / 1 to 1 / 0.003125, except the first, which takes share_candidates from 1 to 0.8. Row 3 is the other split structures' default, 10 / 0.4; row 5 is rpf()'s default for split_structure = "leaf", 3 / 0.1.

Usage

greediness_ladder()

Value

A data.frame with columns n_try_split_points and share_candidates, one row per point, greediest first.

See also

tune_control(), rpf()

Examples

greediness_ladder()
#>    n_try_split_points share_candidates
#> 1                  40         1.000000
#> 2                  20         0.800000
#> 3                  10         0.400000
#> 4                   5         0.200000
#> 5                   3         0.100000
#> 6                   2         0.050000
#> 7                   1         0.025000
#> 8                   1         0.012500
#> 9                   1         0.006250
#> 10                  1         0.003125
